title: Open ingress to a sensitive port
description: Detects aws_security_group and aws_security_group_rule ingress containing 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 when the port range includes 22 or 3389.
remediation: Restrict ingress cidr_blocks to specific trusted corporate CIDRs or a bastion host.

title: Publicly accessible database
description: Detects aws_db_instance resources with publicly_accessible set to true.
remediation: Set publicly_accessible = false and deploy the database inside private subnets.

title: Unencrypted S3 storage
description: Detects aws_s3_bucket resources without an embedded or companion server-side encryption configuration.
remediation: Add aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration with a server-side encryption rule.

title: S3 public access block missing
description: Detects aws_s3_bucket resources without a companion aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource.
remediation: Add a public access block with block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, and restrict_public_buckets set to true.

title: Runtime container runs as root
description: Detects USER root or USER 0 in the final Dockerfile stage. Intermediate stages are reported informationally instead.
remediation: Create a dedicated non-root user and switch to USER appuser.

title: Dockerfile missing USER
description: Detects a final Dockerfile stage without a USER instruction.
remediation: Create a dedicated non-root user and add USER appuser before ENTRYPOINT or CMD.

title: Dockerfile missing HEALTHCHECK
description: Detects a final Dockerfile stage without a HEALTHCHECK instruction.
remediation: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction appropriate for the image.

title: Unpinned image tag
description: Detects FROM images using latest or no tag, excluding scratch and FROM -- forms.
remediation: Pin the image to an exact digest or specific version.

title: Host namespace exposure
description: Detects hostPID, hostIPC, or hostNetwork set to true in a PodSpec.
remediation: Remove hostPID, hostIPC, and hostNetwork flags from the PodSpec.

title: Privileged container
description: Detects securityContext.privileged set to true for a Pod container.
remediation: Set privileged to false and allowPrivilegeEscalation to false.

title: Privilege escalation allowed
description: Detects allowPrivilegeEscalation absent or not false.

title: Container may run as root
description: Detects runAsNonRoot absent or not true.
remediation: Set runAsNonRoot to true and define a non-root runAsUser.

title: Writable root filesystem
description: Detects readOnlyRootFilesystem absent or not true.

title: Insecure Linux capabilities
description: Detects missing drop ALL or additions from the dangerous capability set SYS_ADMIN, NET_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE, NET_RAW, SYS_MODULE, and DAC_OVERRIDE.
remediation: Drop ALL capabilities and remove dangerous additions.

title: Missing Seccomp profile
description: Detects a seccomp profile type other than RuntimeDefault or Localhost.

title: Missing resource limits
description: Detects containers without both CPU and memory limits.
remediation: Define CPU and memory requests and limits.

title: Exact vendor secret match
description: Detects AWS keys, GitHub tokens, Slack tokens, or private-key markers using vendor signature regexes.
remediation: Revoke the token immediately and inject it through an external secret manager.

title: Statistical entropy secret
description: Detects values at least 16 characters long whose Shannon entropy meets the charset-dependent threshold, excluding UUIDs, common hashes, and values containing both slash and dot.
remediation: Remove the high-entropy value and use a secrets manager for runtime injection.
